_comment: Shared verifier/allowlist config used by ALL providers. Each (allowedUrls[i], allowedResponseResolves[i]) PAIR is what the deployed QuoteVerifier accepts. The contract Poseidon2-hashes the URL bytes AND the response_resolve bytes (each zero-padded), then commits the combined hash poseidon2_hash([url_hash, rr_hash]) into a Map<Field, PublicImmutable<bool>>. Binding both prevents a submitter from requesting a different parsePath against the same allow-listed URL and having it recorded as the canonical price. The response_resolve bytes are `keyName + parseType + parsePath` as emitted by the Primus attestor in the signed envelope; for our setup that's 'price' + '' + '<parsePath>'.
